teaser: Nobody refuses to patch by choice: without tests and a pipeline a patch is surgery. The PHP crisis is the moment to invest, not patch once.
core_idea: Organisations took sites down during php2shell because they could not say they were safe, and nobody can be safe without being able to deploy a patch; teams with good tests and pipelines patch routinely, others face surgery, so a system nobody updates is measurable risk and the answer is sustained investment in the pipeline, tests and paid maintenance rather than a one-off fix.

quotes.text: In fact the best teams patch for breakfast.
The ability to patch and the ability to improve are the same ability.
